frontend: mGBA 0.10.5 (the macOS app, mGBA.app), isolated config (XDG_CONFIG_HOME)
input: none in the app: it was started with -t STATE and left running ~25 s, then sent SIGTERM. The game's own save routine ran inside the app and the app wrote the file.
started_from: save state of the libretro mgba core (0.11-212-7a12d6d) under tools/retro-run, taken 2 frames after script line 34 (the press that starts the game's save), with battery RAM dumped at the same moment and placed beside the ROM as the app's .sav.

layout.save_dir: beside the ROM (the app default: savegamePath unset)
layout.name: <ROM file name without extension>.sav
layout.clock: appended to the .sav, no sidecar: GBA 16 bytes (7 BCD time bytes YY MM DD WD hh mm ss, control, u64 lastLatch); GB MBC3 48 bytes (the VBA-M layout libretro mgba writes as .rtc)
layout.written: while the game runs (the .sav is a mapped file), not only on exit

note: proof.png is the libretro mgba core booting with this file as its .srm (screen capture of the app is not permitted here): the game lists the save. 32816 bytes = 32 KiB + a 48-byte MBC3 clock footer, the same layout libretro mgba writes as a separate .rtc (5 x u32 registers, 5 x u32 latched, u64 LE Unix time). Booted without that clock, the game shows TIME ??? ; with the footer passed as .rtc it shows 0:00.
